name: VERTEX
description: A kinetic identity for electric mobility. A pointed shard, deep violet, and a directional compositional system suggest momentum before anything moves.
heading: unbounded
rules: Use forward-facing shards with a shared vanishing direction.
Keep technical details on calm surfaces separate from kinetic graphics.
Ignition is a small action accent, not a body-text color.

system.concept: Prismatic speed studies, directional shards, technical product crops, and a striking violet interface. Momentum lives in geometry while practical information stays steady.
headline: A new direction
for the everyday.
system.productNote: Made for a different kind of momentum.
features: Thoughtful mobility design for the way you actually move.
A clear, considered system from form to information.
A new perspective on everyday journeys.
system.layoutNote: Vector-violet hero with light display text and kinetic shard artwork. Fixed technical panels, forward diagonal decoration, and small ignition-colored labels.
